I work for a company that provides a platform for companies to conduct digital interviews, recorded tests, coding challenges, introductions, etc. Its used for a variety of reason. Our system is very easy to use and have numerous safety measures in place so people do not accidentally begin or record if they are not ready. These includes multiple confirmations, BIG WARNING MESSAGES, brightly colored buttons of different colors, etc. However even with ALL of these measures in place for the official session, we do also offer practice sessions so people can get familiar with our system.

For many reasons, the companies that use our services will often not want people to get multiple chances to record themselves or do a question. If they could, it might mean the person doing the session could cheat. However technical issues may arise during their sessions, which is why my job exists :D

Anyways, so I spoke with this guy recently, let's call him AA for Angry Asshole...

Me: Thank you for contacting [company], my name is Incoherentrant, how may I help.

AA: YEAH IT SAYS MY SESSION IS UNAVAILABLE!

What a nice guy yelling off the bat! After exchanging info and finding what I need, I see that he has already completed it.

Me: From what I see you were able to successfully complete it, so it might be that you refreshed the page by accident and it thinks you are trying to do it again, but no worries as you did successfully submit it.

AA: WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT I DIDN'T DO ANYTHING!

Me: Well it was submitted. Were you not using [our service] at all today?

AA: NO! Well I WAS, but I was just doing the practice, and then it said it was unavailable.

Side note, our service allows you to practice indefinitely if you want, and it only stops the practice once you hit the button that says you want to skip to the real thing. According to our logs, this guy practiced for over an hour, where most people practice for maybe 2-3 minutes since the practice is very basic and teaches you the very simple functions of our service. Also there are messages in multiple places that says it is a practice or the real thing, depending where you are. Interesting enough after an hour of practicing, with the same few samples over and over again he still couldn't figure it out, and it didn't occur to him that he might be in the real session when suddenly after an hour of generic questions, dramatically different/difficult questions started appearing. Oh also the CONFIRMATION that he was starting the real interview, along with a timer countdown...

Me: I do see you were in a practice session, but I do see the point at which you confirmed you wanted to end the practice.

AA: I DIDN'T DO ANYTHING!

Me: Once you officially start it you cannot go back.

AA: So because YOU put me in the real thing, I'm gonna fail? This is your fault, I didn't even know!

Me: Well you did answer the questions though correct?

AA: I TOLD YOU I DIDN'T FUCKING DO ANYTHING. I WAS JUST SKIPPING THROUGH THEM AND READING IT.

Reading? If you were reading sir, you would not be in this predicament...

Me: Well if you would like to do it again, you can reach out to [insert person's name at company]. As a third party we cannot authorize you to redo it, but they can.

AA: I DIDN'T....Grr...I'm gonna fail, I'm gonna fail, this is ridiculous.

Me: Would you like me to get you their contact information?

I then gave him the information, all while he was yelling at me to repeat the email and what not.

Me: Do you have any other questions I might be able to assist with?

AA: THAT'S A FUCKING LOADED QUESTION click

And then I smiled he was out of my life forever.
"My inability to read is your fault, and my failing of this is on you!"
And then I smiled he was out of my life forever.
